bodies.name: ideas-20261018-gpu-final-0000000000000000
cmd:
set -eu
mkdir -p /root/cryptanalysis
cd /root/cryptanalysis
curl --fail --location --retry 3 --output /tmp/ideas-payload.tar.gz https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aburan28/cryptanalysis/19883bd4c601c93387e7fb281b13d701a2ac5337/experiments/ideas_gpu_20261018/remote-payload-v5.tar.gz
printf '%s  %s\n' e269ad82ff1ff7724d88ccd34adf3752f642f9895f2dd015889315245fbfcfd4 /tmp/ideas-payload.tar.gz | sha256sum -c -
tar -xzf /tmp/ideas-payload.tar.gz
exec python3 experiments/ideas_gpu_20261018/remote_http_gpu_v3.py --out /root/cryptanalysis/experiments/ideas_gpu_20261018/remote/run-gpu-v3
